name: Dr Yashika De Silva
bio: Dr Yashika De Silva is a dedicated and compassionate GP who believes in treating each patient as a whole person. She has accumulated valuable experience across all aspects of general practice and is known for her empathetic, thorough approach to care. Dr Yashika takes the time to listen to her patients' concerns and works collaboratively to develop personalised health plans.
detailedBio: Dr Yashika De Silva completed her medical degree and went on to achieve Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), demonstrating her commitment to the highest standards of general practice. She has a particular passion for women's health and preventive medicine, helping patients understand and take control of their long-term wellbeing. Dr Yashika believes strongly in the doctor-patient relationship and strives to make every consultation a positive and empowering experience.
billingNote: Bulk billing available for children under 12 on weekdays between 8:30am and 4:00pm.
